lines.en: label christmalloween1:
scene makotoxmasangy1
: Have you all gone mad?! Christmalloween?! So we’re just making up holidays now?! Is that what this world has come to?!
: What’s gotten into Makoto? Since when does anybody have a problem with Christmalloween? This is the one day of the year everyone is supposed to come together and celebrate the birth of candy.
scene makotoxmasangy2
: The birth of candy?! That’s not a thing! You’re combining two different holidays! There’s Christmas and there’s Halloween! Pick one!
: You better be careful Makoto. At this rate, Santa’s going to hop off his skeletal reindeer just to put your ass in the naughty grimoire. Then it’s nothing but bones for you until next year.
: Is there a fucking gas leak in here or something?! What is happening?!
: Beats me. But you’re being a real Ichabod Scrooge right now.
: I hope no one’s spiked the pumpkin nog...I already had some. And I can’t think of any other reason Makoto would flip on her Christmalloween stance other than being drunk.
: Yeah, Makoto! What friggin’ gives?
scene makotoxmasangy3
: You love Christmalloween. You make me help ya find a dead tree to decorate with candy wrappers every single year. The heck happened?
: It’s gotta be the imbalance. Makoto clearly cares more about the “Christ” part of “Christmalloween” than the “Malloween” part and Malloween costumes are trending right now.
: There is no Malloween! It’s Halloween! And Christmas!
scene makotoxmasangy4
: Chill, girl. If you want to go change, nobody will hold it against you. And Sana’s got enough costume to go around. Just take some of hers.
: I want...to keep the claws, though...I feel like they...might come in handy...
: I don’t want to change! It’s all of you who should change! Today’s probably not even a real holiday! Someone tell me the date!
: It’s November 18th, Makoto. The same as every Christmalloween.
: Then what the fuck is October 31st?! Or December 25th?! Huh?!
: Makoto, you’re gonna need to keep it down or you’re gonna set off Miku’s PTSD again. And she looks too cute today to be freaking out and crying.
: I can’t help it! This is all just fucking insane! Christmalloween isn’t real! None of this is real!
: I’m guessing that shirt ain’t real either then?
: What shirt? I’m not-
scene makotoxmasangy5
scene makotoxmasangy6
: FUCK!
scene makotoxmasangy7
: You know, Kirin — I’m a big fan of the new you. This is the most innocent and least revealing costume you’ve probably ever had.
: At least since I was like twelve, yeah.
scene makotoxmasangy8
: It feels kind of weird, though. I haven’t gotten in trouble yet.
: Hell, I haven’t even hit on Imani yet and that’s basically become a Christmalloween tradition for me.
: You did hit on me, though. But I’m going to assume that’s mostly just because you think I’m a wolf and read some weird sort of Little Red Riding Hood doujinshi or something.
scene makotoxmasangy9
: Sorry. Are you not a wolf?
: No, I’ve told you a million times. I’m a hellhound. Loona? From that show I made you watch?
: The one with all the cursing and weird demon sex?
: Yeah, that one.
: Right. Yeah, I’m still going to keep calling you a wolf. It just makes more sense and goes with my costume.
: That seems very culturally insensitive to my hellhound pack and people. You’re lucky canines are prone to domestication and loyalty, otherwise I might try to change your ways.
scene makotoxmasangy10
: Hey, speaking of domestication and loyalty, where’s your master? I need to show him I’m not a slut anymore and hope he still likes me.
: Of course he’ll still like you, Kirin. I’m not a slut and he loves me.
: Sure, but you have redeeming qualities and I just need to bank on my blowjob skills carrying my entire existence.
scene makotoxmasangy11
: You have plenty of redeeming qualities, Kirin! You’re protective and kind and caring and the only reason you act up is because you’re overly sensitive and misguided.
: But, if we’re being real, I imagine the blowjob thing is currently higher up on Onii-chan’s quality ranking than any of those other aspects of your character.
scene makotoxmasangy12
: So hey, maybe he likes you even more than me. It’s not like those skills go away just because you’re wearing a costume.
: And if I know anything about my big brother, it’s that the innocence of said costume will probably just make him like you more.
: It’s kind of sad that that is the primary quality you know about him. I’m not going to argue with it if it gives me some kind of advantage, though. I need all the help I can get.
scene makotoxmasangy13
: What’s the next move then? Are you going to try and win his heart for real tonight?
: I don’t know...And I feel kind of weird talking to you about it when you’re after the same thing.
: Sure, I get that. I just can’t keep my status as a martyr without trying to help you right now. And I’ve worked hard for that status, Little Red Riding Whore.
scene makotoxmasangy14
: Oh, that was good. Nice one, Noriko.
: Chika’s not here yet so somebody needs to insult you in the meantime in order for you to keep your groove.
: Can we just have another threesome and then both of us can win? It’s hard for me to be as nice as you when it comes to our rivalry now.
: I’m struggling to understand what sort of sense that would make from a character and roleplay perspective. Even if we just decide on me being a wolf.
scene makotoxmasangy15
: Unless...Onii-chan dresses up as a wolf as well and we...group up to...dominate the girl that...
: Uhh-
scene makotoxmasangy16
: Switch costumes with me. There’s something I need to do.
: Keep your furry fantasies out of my life. I don’t want to dress up as a wolf just so you can have the experience of fucking double bestiality or whatever.
scene makotoxmasangy17
: But I’d do it for you!
: I know you would! Because you’re a better person than me. And, no offense, but I kind of just care about myself right now.
scene makotoxmasangy18
: My entire relationship with Sensei is predicated on sex and I...I want more now. I want him to really like me. Not just...trick himself into thinking he...you know.
: And I could be completely wrong here, but my instincts are telling me that if I’m going to make that happen, I need to actually connect with him on an emotional level.
: That...is how most relationships are formed, yes.
: How the fuck am I supposed to do that, though? He’s so confusing and pitiful that I just straight up don’t even know how to talk to him.
: You just do it, Kirin. You’re making it sound way harder than it actually is.
scene makotoxmasangy19
: Onii-chan might be a creepy pervert that your parents would never be okay with you dating. And pursuing him could possibly ruin your relationship with your sister and your best friend-
: Sorry, is that actually supposed to be convincing? Or are you just subtly trying to talk me out of this right now?
: ...but what really matters after all is said and done is you.
: You want someone you can just sit down and talk about your day with, right? Someone who will be there regardless of what you’re willing to trade?
: Then just fucking talk to him, idiot. He might be creepy, but he does have the capacity of caring for someone.
: He has thoughts and feelings and wants to talk about them just as much as anybody. He just kind of sucks at it and needs somebody to hold his hand.
scene makotoxmasangy20
: We have to hold hands?! Isn’t it a little soon for that?!
: Didn’t you guys make out in the middle of a restaurant once?
: Yeah, but we didn’t hold hands!
: He’s literally ejaculated inside of you.
: What part of this “holding hands” thing are you not getting, Noriko?!
: Kirin, he’ll be here any minute. And when he gets here, you’ve gotta just go for it.
: Don’t be like me and let everyone else step in front of you. Because I may be young, but that’s currently my greatest regret. And I love you too much to let you hurt yourself too.
scene makotoxmasangy21
: Do you love me enough to practice holding hands with me?
: Do I look like a prostitute to you, Kirin?
scene makotoxmasangy22
: Th-There! He’s here! What do I-
: Onii-chan! Hi! Kirin wants to talk to you about something!
: Noriko! Don’t just throw me under the bus like that-
: Kirin is going to have to wait. I need to talk to Makoto about something.
: Oh, thank fucking god. Everyone here has gone insane and I hate this fucking sweater.
: I bought that for you! You said you loved it!
: Should I come too? Or-
scene makotoxmasangy23
: There’s really no need for that, is there? We trust Sensei enough to let him talk to Makoto for a few minutes without anything happening, don’t we?
: Not really, no.
scene makotoxmasangy24
: Happy Christmalloween, Supreme Overlord! Do not let the one with two sets of eyes deceive you into believing such a joyous day does not exist.
: Also, please do not open the green bag in the bedroom. Thank you in advance for your cooperation.
: Uh...you’re welcome?
: Could you please turn on the lights as well? Thank you in advance for your cooperation.
scene makotoxmasangy25
: For the tenth time, just take the mask off. I won’t be offended.
: No, keep it on. I like it.
: Makoto. Bedroom. Now.
scene black
: Right here?! With all of us outside of the door?! We’ve yet to even spin a bottle!
: Not a fan of how you worded that, Senpai! Also, hi. Happy Christmalloween. Please avoid looking at Rika. Her skirt is far too short and you may see something you will never be able to unsee.
: I don’t mind...so long as it’s you, Akira...
: Mom! Please go put something else on! Literally everyone won’t stop looking at you!
: That’s why I’m standing next to Sana! She’s supposed to distract everyone from- ah! Akira, please! Not in front of the-
: I need this room for a minute. Don’t eavesdrop.
scene makotoxmasangy26
: I feel like you could have and should have been exponentially more subtle about this.
: Pulling me into a room by yourself is definitely not helping your image out, Sensei. You should have let Ayane join us at the very least. Regardless of what Ami had to say.
: The last thing I want to do right now is make Ami suspicious. What do you remember? Why do you love Christmalloween?
scene makotoxmasangy27
: I don’t! I woke up in the middle of this blasted party and was already wearing this fucking sweater! I hate Christmalloween! And I hate that everyone thinks that it’s real!
: That’s like me and monks.
: Monks are real! Don’t tell me you’ve been brainwashed too?!
: Not the kind I’m talking about, but the point remains. Something is definitely wrong here and we need to figure out what.
scene makotoxmasangy28
: Ayane and I both have memories of something we don’t remember experiencing. And if you’re the same way, it might actually give us some sort of lead.
: Well, what kind of memories are you talking about exactly? Because all I really remember is needing to create a macaroni portrait of a horse-man. And something about sticks I think?
: First, have you said anything about the apocalypse to Ami?
scene makotoxmasangy29
: Makoto...
scene makotoxmasangy30
: It was right after I learned about all this stuff, okay?! I had no idea what was going on and it made sense to me to try and find out if she did!
scene makotoxmasangy31
: It was no use, though. She just did the same thing everyone else does and kept repeating the last thing she said to me. So I doubt she remembers me trying to talk to her about it at all.
: That’s it? She didn’t, like...freak out or anything?
scene makotoxmasangy32
: Not at all. It was like talking to a parrot, really. A very annoying, incestuous parrot.
: Huh...okay. Well, that’s...good news? I think?
: Was that all?
: No. The second involves Maya. And about how this might...be her fault in some sort of way?
scene makotoxmasangy33
: What? How does that make sense? She was literally reset, wasn’t she? Why would she do that to herself?
: I have no idea. And I don’t even know if it’s true either. I just...felt that way once the reset ended. And while I know it’s not really a lead we can follow-
scene makotoxmasangy34
: No, it’s a good place to start. And it gives us more of a reason to implement her in some of our experiments going forward.
: Experiments?
scene makotoxmasangy33
: What we were talking about during the beach meeting before everything collapsed again.
: You don’t remember that, do you?
: It’s...kind of there. But yeah, none of the details came with me.
: Well, the gist was that we run a series of tests to try and push the boundaries of the world. And I wanted to incorporate Maya since she’d been so relevant in the past.
: To think this would somehow be her fault though, just...doesn’t make much sense to me at the moment. But it’s something we can explore going forward.
: And how do you propose we do that? Starting right now.
: Right now, I’m more concerned about the fact that national holidays are suddenly being affected by the loops. That’s never happened before, has it?
: Not to my knowledge, no. So who knows what else could have changed this time?
: Well, what do you suggest we do in order to find out? Act normal and slowly uncover any differences? Or maybe crash out like I was doing until you got here?
: Let me talk to Ayane a little more. We’ll try to find a way that all three of us can get together and- wait. Have you heard from Yumi at all? She was at the party too, wasn’t she?
scene makotoxmasangy35
: I haven’t had time to check my phone, but I imagine she’ll be here soon enough seeing as there’s free food.
: Yeah, that’s a safe bet. Talk to her when she gets here, okay? That’s the mission I’m giving you.
: Sure, but...
: But what?
: It’s just...
: Aren’t you acting a little more responsible and proactive than normal right now?
: What?
scene makotoxmasangy36
: You’re just normally so lackadaisical when it comes to all of this stuff that having you drag me aside out of nowhere to hear my thoughts and delegate responsibilities is, like...
scene makotoxmasangy37
: Kind of hot...
: Makoto. Really?
: What? I like authority and it feels like you’re actually in charge right now. Sue me.
scene makotoxmasangy38
: Keep it in your pants. We need to- Makoto. Stop blushing.
: The stricter you are with me, the hornier I will become. I am not proud, but this is who I am.
: Hah...
: Just keep an eye out for Yumi, okay? And don’t go back out there until your face is less red.
scene makotoxmasangy39
: Can you at least grope me or something so I can calm down?
: No. I have things to figure out right now.
scene black
: Ah!
: Oi! What’s going on in- oh, Senpai. You’re already out. Then what was that noise I just-
: Yeah, Makoto’s acting weird. Also, I couldn’t convince her Christmalloween is a real holiday that we all celebrate every year. Ayane, where are you?
: H-Here! Hello!
: Wait! Sensei! Uhh...if you have a minute-
: It’s going to have to wait, Kirin. Sorry. Ayane, come on. Let’s talk more outside.
: Coming!
: Hah...
: That’s fine...
: I just have to wait a little while...
Meanwhile...
